# ChatGPT Web contract fixture

`6.1.0.json` was generated by evaluating `src/chatgpt-web-models.ts` from
miuuyy/codex-chatgpt-web commit `293341084ac7a1ddd2de12fede3706023f5b6474`.
The source is pure TypeScript and can be evaluated with Node 24 type stripping
from a temporary `.mts` file; it has no runtime dependencies or credentials.

For each combination of interaction mode, Sol, Pro, Extra High, Bigger Context,
and manual Pro, call `availableChatGptWebModelRoutes(config, true)`, then
`chatGptWebRouteEfforts(route, config)` and
`resolveChatGptWebContextLimits(route.backendModel, route.adapterEffort, config)`.
Skip manual Bigger Context (explicitly rejected upstream) and vary manual Pro
only in manual mode. The resulting 32 cases are independent reference data for
the Router adapter, not values derived from its implementation.

When adopting another Web release, review that source, `model-catalog.ts`, and
the `/healthz` schema before replacing this fixture and the supported version.
